dataList.content:
The stage Meursault stands on is made of irrationality.
不合理的舞台。

Meursault struggles hopelessly against the currents. Alone. Abandoned without a role.
在那之上，默尔索甚至没有得到正经的角色，只是被不断地推远。

And standing in the gloom, I can only watch as the tides carry him away.
在那漆黑的黑暗中，我只能凝视着被推走的默尔索。

Just as the helplessness began to wear me down, in that stifling silence of the darkness that refused to answer anything...
正当我无计可施，对黑暗中这无人应答的寂静感到疲惫时……

The sunshine found me.
阳光接近了我。

Something's weighing on your mind, Dante.
你看上去很烦恼，但丁。

Or... are you afraid, perhaps? Afraid of the choices to come?
还是说，你在害怕？害怕即将面临做出选择的瞬间。

Meursault warned me against talking with the sunlight—that I shouldn't look into it for too long...
虽然默尔索警告过，不要和阳光说话，也不要长时间注视……

... but it was nearly impossible to resist its compassionate warmth when I was surrounded by nothing but the frost of the frustrating, endless silence.
但面对在焦躁不安，无计可施的时候传来的……温暖的声音，不作回应实在是太难了。

<... I am afraid.>
<……嗯。>
can't seem to know anything. And that makes me... afraid.> <和你不同，我……因为一无所知……所以害怕。>

Hmm... I'm not sure how much I ought to reveal to you, but...
唔……虽然不清楚说到哪里比较好……

I wasn't all that different, Dante.
不过我也……和你没什么差别，但丁。

I... was trying to build a new set of rules above the rules of the City.
我……一直为在这都市的规则之上建立新的规则而努力。

And that was when I met two children from the Outskirts.
之后，我遇到了两个从郊区来的孩子。

And one of them... while they assumed the form of a human, ■■■ ■■■■■ ■■■ ■■ ■■■...
其中一个……虽然是人的模样，■■■■■……

<Wait, I didn't hear—>
<刚刚那句话……>

Haha, I always end up confusing myself when I'm telling you these stories. I never know where I should start the tale... or where I should end it.
呵呵。每次和你对话的时候，总会有些搞不清。像是要从哪儿说起……要说多少比较好之类的。

Anyway... I had to use that special child I met in the Outskirts for an experiment.
总之，我不得不把在郊区遇到的那个特殊的孩子用在了实验上。

Without sacrificing that child... we couldn't have gotten hold of the Singularity.
如果不牺牲那孩子……就没办法抓住奇点了。

But everything I believed in, the values whispering from behind me... made it impossible to accept sacrificing a child. Even if it were to connect the stars.
可就我的价值观而言……我无法接受牺牲孩子这种事。即使是为了连接星星。

Well, now... I paint the world as I wish, but... it was truly, truly terrifying then.
虽然现在……我按照自己的愿望涂抹了世界……但那时候的我真的非常害怕。

My work didn't just end at making a new set of rules over those of the City—I had to stand against those who... tried to preserve the status quo...
只是定下规则并不代表结束。因为必须和那些守护现有规则的人们……相互对抗……

I'm sure it wasn't just me. Everyone who had followed me must have felt the same way.
不只是我，跟随我的同伴们也一定都是这么想的吧。

"... Death could come for us at any moment."
“我们不知何时会死去。”

"Everything we've built up could come to nothing."
“迄今为止的一切心血，或许都会化作泡影。”

"This is it. There's nowhere else for us to go if this fails."
“如果失败，我们甚至无处可归……”

Every one of those concerns chipped away at the faith we had in our plan.
就连它能实现的这一信念本身也渐渐变得稀薄。

And there's that doubt that always rears its head at moments like those.
每每想到那里，我都会忽然浮出思考。

"What is any of this worth?"
“这一切又有什么价值呢？”

How about it, Dante? Doesn't that sound familiar?
怎么样，但丁。和你的想法……是不是很像？

<... It's familiar—no, I've had that exact thought before.>
<……很像。不，应该说是一样的。>

It wasn't a brief, momentary concern, either. I've heard that same question echoed many times since the beginning of our journey.
自从踏上这段旅程以来，我始终抱有这个烦恼。
Even among countless other anxieties we carried on our backs... that phrase perfectly captured that one anxiety that refused to recede, no matter how far we got. 即使背下所有的不安，一路来到这里……不安也丝毫没有消退。

What kind of person is Meursault to you?
对你而言，默尔索是怎么样的人？

<A... Sinner. I think.>
<罪人……吧。>

<Someone who used to be an N Corp. resident until he was exiled... Someone who gives me sound advice... and has excellent memory...>
<曾经在N公司生活，之后被驱逐……总是毫不吝啬地向我提出建议，记忆力非常好……>

This is no different from the gaze Meursault bears on a daily basis.
这样盘点下去也只是一如既往地凝视默尔索而已。

And... that does precisely nothing. It can't be the helping hand he needs.
这样下去……没办法帮到他。没办法向他伸出援手。

What can I do, then?
那么我又能做什么呢。

What can I possibly do when I haven't the slightest idea whether any of this was—is—worth it?
在对这一切……是否具有价值都无从知晓的情况下，我能做什么呢。

<How... did you endure those anxieties?>
<你是……怎么忍受这种不安的？>

... I couldn't, Dante.
……我没能忍受，但丁。

Their gaze bore into my heart like a harpoon, and it hurt so much that—
那所有的视线，都如同鱼叉一样……太过疼痛地深深刺入我的内心。

A child was dead. And we were so gripped by that guilt that we— I was pushed to the absolute brink that I—
明明一个孩子死去了啊，被那份负罪感拦住脚步的我们，被推了一把的我……

... A choice had to be made. A choice in place of persisting through it.
最终，只能以选择代替忍耐。

<What choice?>
<什么选择？>

To use me to complete the project.
用我自己来完成计划。

To discard me, to sacrifice me for our purpose.
甚至舍弃自己，用牺牲来达成目标。
That Singularity we seized through that child... could only be extracted from me. 因为通过那孩子抓住的奇点……只能从我身上取出。

With all that guilt, all that remorse inside me... I resolved to let go of my life...
怀揣着所有的罪恶感与负罪感……我决定放弃生命……

I slid deeper... and deeper... into the bathtub,
将自己沉入浴缸之中……

letting my eyelids fall. And once darkness rushed in...
缓缓地阖上双眼……
... I became... afraid. It was more overwhelming than any fear I'd ever felt, deeper and more viscous than any despair I'd suffered. It was just... different. 随后极端的恐惧袭来。那……和我以往以来感受到的任何绝望都截然不同。

It was a cry... for life.
那是对生命的……呐喊。

<You didn't want to die.>
<你并不想死。>

I think Meursault and Jeanne are much like me, despite appearances.
事实上，虽然看上去可能有些陌生，但默尔索和让娜也和我没什么差别吧。

We're all people who can't find acceptance anywhere, crying out because the rejection has become unbearable.
都是在迫切中呐喊的，无处容纳自己的人。

But isn't that true for every single person in the City, at least to some degree?
只是程度不同而已，都市的人们不都是这样吗？

They're crying so that they won't be forgotten by the world. So that rip currents won't carry them away and drown them.
为了不被世界遗忘，不被推开，不感到窒息。

Dante, think about it. What can you do for Meursault?
但丁。你能为默尔索做些什么呢。
Just what are you, that you should be the one to lead them all? 你到底是什么样的存在，才会去带领他们呢。

<... All I can do is... struggle,>
<……我或许，只能挣扎吧。>

<still harrowed by the anxieties of what tomorrow might hold...>
<怀揣着对前路一无所知的不安……>
Who am I? What am I? 那么。我究竟是谁。我究竟是什么呢。

Am I a manager who leads the Sinners? A year ago, I was saddled with that title against my wishes. Is that really... what I am?
引导罪人们的执行经理……一年前，违背我的愿望被迫接受的这个称呼……真的是我吗。

Don Quixote's family. Ryōshū's friend. Gregor's comrade. Outis's superior. Hong Lu's colleague. Sinclair's adult. Heathcliff's confidant. Ishmael's compass. Yi Sang's fellow. Faust's—Rodya's—Vergilius's—Charon's—Meursault's—
堂吉诃德的家人。良秀的朋友。格里高尔的战友，奥提斯的长官，鸿璐的同伴，辛克莱的家长，希斯克利夫的知己，以实玛利的罗盘，李箱的友人，浮士德的，罗佳的，维吉里乌斯的，卡戎的，默尔索的……

I realize that everything that came to mind when I thought of myself... is constructed by the gaze of others.
脑中浮现出有关于我的一切……都是他人之视线塑造出的。

What am I without their gaze?
如此一来，摆脱所有视线后，我还剩下什么呢。
What, other than others, could prove me? 离开他人后，我要依靠什么来证明自身的存在。

Once Meursault has shaken free from my gaze...
摆脱我所有视线的默尔索……

... what becomes of the entity that lies underneath?
那一存在，又会剩下什么。

What anchors his existence?
是什么让他得以存在呢。

He met my gaze, and I his.
我们视线相交。

Seeing the cold fire that burned in his eyes, I decided not to reach out with my hand, my words, or anything at all.
望着那冷静而饱含激情的眼神……我既没有伸出手，也没有说出心中所想。

I simply placed my anticipation, my expectation on that existence before me.
只是对那一存在抱有期待而已。
